name: Vocab Match
description: Two quick match-the-pairs rounds (French words, then inventors) with a leaderboard — the template for any vocab/definitions review.

intro.message:
🔗 VOCAB MATCH!

Two rounds. Drag the right column on your device so every row is a correct pair. Every correct match earns points — fastest fingers don't matter, correct ones do.

round1.prompt: Match each French word to its English meaning

round2.prompt: Match each invention to its inventor

end.message: 🔗 That's Vocab Match! Swap in your own pairs for any unit review.
